title: I'm Done with Fighting Games
overview: Aya goes to boarding school to become a proper young lady, only to find the school idol gaming in secret.

title: Good Game
overview: Aya tries to lay low after nearly getting caught gaming, but Mio has her heart set on a rematch.

title: Late-Night Locals
overview: Aya and Mio discover the perfect gaming spot, only for the dorm monitors to catch them red-handed.

title: Late-Night Study Sessions
overview: Looming exams bring Mio to tears. Can she put her stick down long enough to earn a passing grade?

title: The Night Before
overview: The girls decide to enter a tournament in Tokyo, but Mio needs permission from her game-hating mother.

title: A Noble Duel
overview: A balance patch nerfs Aya's main and buff's Mio's. Mio sets out to master a new technique.

title: The Lesser Devil
overview: The girls play their first tournament matches, to mixed results, while two pros settle an old score.

title: Guaranteed to Lose
overview: Aya and Mio find themselves playing against pros. Are they destined to drown in pools?

title: Playing for Fun
overview: Aya and Mio struggle after a strong start. Tamaki tries to find fun in her match with Arisa.

title: But I Did Think It
overview: Aya's match is over, but Mio's is still heating up. Watching her friend play shakes Aya's confidence.
